title: Managed Backup: commitment cancellation
content:
For Managed Backup, the following tier basis defines commitment cancellation.

## Tier basis

**Permission to forgive an unexpired commitment on customer termination.** Whether customer termination forgives an unexpired signed commitment; boolean.

| Contract tier | Permission to forgive an unexpired commitment on customer termination |
| --- | --- |
| Northbridge Managed Backup 5 TB | No |
| Northbridge Managed Backup 10 TB | No |
| Northbridge Managed Backup 25 TB | No |
| Northbridge Managed Backup 50 TB | No |
| Northbridge Managed Backup 100 TB | No |
| Northbridge Managed Backup 250 TB | No |

## Tier lookup

For the Northbridge Managed Backup 5 TB tier, permission to forgive an unexpired commitment on customer termination is No.

## Hypothetical comparison

In a hypothetical switch between any of the listed tiers, permission to forgive an unexpired commitment on customer termination stays the same.
